text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize it had gotten this late...
But... right now, I want to keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Uni-san?
Didn't you already head out for the day...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was making "preparations."
Let's go……to the "observation point."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Observation...?
Wait, hold on, Uni-san~?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Target point "reached"... check.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The academy's... rooftop...?
Wasn't this place supposed to be locked at this hour...?
choice_data_list: It's fine, I have permission from the academy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...?
What on earth is the meaning of this?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Today is "FULM"... so it's "moon viewing."
This is the best "observation point" in the academy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: M-Moon-viewing...? Besides, the dorm curfew is—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I've already talked to Hishiama about it, and I'm here as a supervisor representing both dorms.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even Fuji-senpai... !?
choice_data_list: I just wanted you to catch your breath for once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could sense a feeling of impatience in her recent running.
I asked for their help, hoping that talking with a peer and an experienced senior might resolve it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But... I need to get stronger.
If I just take it easy, it'll take forever...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of the new generation grows stronger by the day.
I need the strength to keep from being swallowed up by it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is "observing" too.
A very strong light. "STIN", isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If one were swallowed up by it,
it feels as though any brilliance would be erased...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: When I thought about it that way... I just couldn't sit still.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. When faced with a massive wall,
no matter what we do, looking up at it only fills us with fear.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you know, it's times like these when you should look at your feet.
Because there is a solid path you have walked to get here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you can see the path, you won't stumble.
Any anxiety you're carrying should naturally ease up too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy's strength... has been "observed" by everyone.
Even without "communication," there is "understanding."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
People are paying attention to you
far more than you might realize.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san... Fuji-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Stay strong in your heart.
Let confidence shine in your eyes, and march forward with your head held high.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. I made a pledge at the museum last year.
To believe in my own potential...!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Believe in your own brilliance.
Beyond that... your grandest wish will surely come true.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! I will spin a story...
A story that won't lose to the brilliance of the new generation...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four... All right!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, Zenno Rob Roy could be seen running,
not with an anguished look, but with a strangely bright expression...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira.
...It's okay.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because Zenno Rob Roy will leave behind
many stories that rival even the first-magnitude stars.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ……“CONT”。

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... Excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho!
Zenno Rob Roy on the inside!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes Zenno Rob Roy charging in!
Pushing hard through the gap, Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Was that... a race I don't know...?
Was the one running... me...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Uni-san.
Right now, my dream—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
While "observing" the "moon"... "EMPT,"
"dango"... they look kinda similar.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing at all.
Shall we eat the dango?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right.
The "MTRSI" is delicious, you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The continuation of that dream from earlier...
I hope I can see it someday."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy felt her heart inexplicably flutter at the thought of a brilliant future yet unknown even to herself.
